jcr:title: The iSuite Experience
thumbnailAltText: Operating room, Stryker Operating Room, iSuite, Operating Theater, Integrated operating room
jcr:description: You are team-oriented. We are too. Together we share a common goal of providing exceptional patient care. This begins with the iSuite - your customized, efficient, seamlessly integrated operating room. To create your iSuite, our team will guide you through the entire process, one we’ve successfully completed thousands of times. This includes designing and planning your room, providing world-class equipment and connecting your OR to the world.

operational efficiency and patient and staff satisfaction.

text_526878721.text: You are team-oriented. We are too. Together we share a common goal of providing exceptional patient care. This begins with the iSuite - your customized, efficient, seamlessly integrated operating room. To create your iSuite, our team will guide you through the entire process, one we’ve successfully completed thousands of times. This includes designing and planning your room, providing world-class equipment and connecting your OR to the world.

text.text:
World class operating rooms
designed for safer, more efficient patient care.

numbercounter_copy.counterlabel:
Reduction in trips and falls

Increased safety: Reduce consequential trips and falls by 93% by reducing your equipment footprint in the operating room.1

numbercounter_copy_c.counterlabel:
Man hours per case

Increased productivity: Increase the productivity of surgical staff by 0.8 man hours per case with devices that are quickly and easily controlled.1

numbercounter_copy_7.counterlabel:
Minute reduction in turnovers

Increased efficiency: The iSuite provides an average of 11 minutes reduction in room turnover time with effective room set-up.1

text_copy.text:
Experience the latest
from Stryker.

Oculan Lighting Platform

Redefining the standard of surgical lighting.

text.text:
Connected OR Platform

Created to Connect.

Fortress Modular Wall System

Prefabricated stainless steel OR walls, that consolidates construction timelines, provides durability and flexibility.

Reimagine your OR

Design your critical care spaces with Stryker's propriety software ByDesign.

text_copy.text:
Surgical Tables 

From General Surgery to Orthopaedics, our surgical table line can meet the needs of variety of surgical disciplines.

text_copy_copy.text:
Customize your iSuite
with Stryker's complete line of integrated equipment.

text.text: From surgical tables, lights and equipment management, to routers and cables, Stryker offers all the major equipment for a fully integrated OR suite. Create a unique, customized environment, regardless of your specialty.

References

  1. "Based on a study of 106 OR personnel (surgeons, OR managers and circulating nurses) in US hospitals that have Stryker integrated operating rooms, the following information was concluded: Consequential trips and falls were reduced by 93%; An average decrease of 0.8 man-hours per case was found; Room turnover was shortened by 11 minutes on average; 95% of circulating nurses surveyed said there was no need to locate mobile equipment in order to set up the room for surgery. Improving OR Efficiency and Economics with Stryker iSuite Integration.” (pp. 3-14, White Paper). Frost and Sullivan. 2015.
